gold_sql:
WITH p1 AS (
  SELECT ST_Value(d.rast, 1, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-87.732089 41.72357)',4326)) AS elev
  FROM public.dem_us d
  WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-87.732089 41.72357)',4326))
  LIMIT 1
),
p2 AS (
  SELECT ST_Value(d.rast, 1, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-87.654322 40.146491)',4326)) AS elev
  FROM public.dem_us d
  WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-87.654322 40.146491)',4326))
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  ABS(p1.elev - p2.elev) AS elevation_difference_m,
  p1.elev AS poi1_elevation_m,
  p2.elev AS poi2_elevation_m
FROM p1, p2;

```sql
WITH hospital_geom AS (
  SELECT ST_SetSRID(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-87.732089 41.72357)'), 4326)::geometry AS geom
),
park_geom AS (
  SELECT ST_SetSRID(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-87.654322 40.146491)'), 4326)::geometry AS geom
),
hospital_elevation AS (
  SELECT (ST_Value(r.rast, h.geom)).[1] AS elevation
  FROM public.dem_us r
  CROSS JOIN hospital_geom h
  WHERE ST_Intersects(r.rast, h.geom)
),
park_elevation AS (
  SELECT (ST_Value(r.rast, p.geom)).[1] AS elevation
  FROM public.dem_us r
  CROSS JOIN park_geom p
  WHERE ST_Intersects(r.rast, p.geom)
)
SELECT 
  ABS((SELECT elevation FROM hospital_elevation) - (SELECT elevation FROM park_elevation)) AS elevation_gap;
```
